description: This file defines the InterviewDecorator class in the OrangeHRM system, implementing methods to manipulate and retrieve information about Interview entities, including setting related CandidateVacancy, Candidate, and Employee entities, as well as formatting interview date and time.

classes.name: InterviewDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class that provides additional methods to manipulate and access interview-related data, such as setting candidate and interviewer information and formatting interview date/time.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with an Interview entity instance.

methods.name: setCandidateVacancyById
methods.description: Sets the CandidateVacancy associated with the interview using an ID.

methods.name: setCandidateById
methods.description: Sets the Candidate associated with the interview using an ID.

methods.name: setInterviewerByEmpNumbers
methods.description: Associates multiple Employees as interviewers based on their employee numbers.

methods.name: addInterviewer
methods.description: Adds an Employee to the interviewers collection if not already present.

methods.name: removeInterviewers
methods.description: Removes all interviewers from the interview.

methods.name: getInterviewTime
methods.description: Retrieves the formatted interview time if available.
